subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The Bugatti Veyron
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Bugatti Veyron.

hook.text: Volkswagen told engineers to build a 1,000-horsepower car that hits 250 mph. They said it was impossible.

buildup.text: The Veyron used a quad-turbo W16 engine—essentially two V8s fused together making 1,001 horsepower.

discovery.text: It hit 253 mph, making it the fastest production car in the world when launched in 2005.

twist.text: VW lost about $6 million on every Veyron sold. It cost $1.5 million but cost far more to build.

climax.text: Just 450 were made. The Veyron proved that no speed barrier is truly impossible with enough engineering.

punchline.text: The Veyron was a money-losing masterpiece.

quiz.question: How much did VW lose on each Veyron?
